task: Fix the supervisor history compactor so a sub-agent's intermediate tool-call AIMessage is never mistaken for its terminal handoff answer, add a tool_calls guard to _consume_pending_handoff_message, and cover the exact bug shape with a regression test.

key_reasoning.reason: The change is a single, self-contained guard in _consume_pending_handoff_message (src/codemie/agents/supervisor/history.py), but that function is shared infrastructure invoked for every supervisor-based multi-agent handoff in the system — a targeted fix with system-wide behavioral reach.

No exact precedent exists on main for this specific guard (a similar concept exists only on the unmerged EPMCDME-13889 reference branch), and the 603-line existing regression suite exercises many overlapping message-shape scenarios (parallel handoffs, placeholders, orphan sanitization) that the change must not break; the trailing sanitize_rich_history_for_llm sweep can also mask the true effect of the fix, requiring careful assertions rather than just 'no crash'.
